note: Björn action contracts for the opening action scenes

contracts.beat: storm — Björn hauls the steering-oar; the crest becomes the seam
contracts.initial: SŌLFARI beam-on to a hill-high black wave; BJÖRN hauls the steering-oar by main strength, Himinkljúfr on his back; OLAF lashed, failing; ASTRID shouting reads
contracts.trajectory: Björn throws his full weight to take the wave bow-first; the crest curls to break
contracts.contact: where foam should be the water UNRAVELS into a seam of gold light
contracts.consequence: the ship is driven through; Björn useless against the sea (deep-water dread seeded)
contracts.raccord: hard cut to the two-worlds stack (SC03)
contracts.weaponCostume: Himinkljúfr slung (not drawn); crew soaked; Olaf grey
contracts.camera: locked wide → hard push on the unravelling crest

contracts.beat: the crossing — Björn tries to cut the light, fails (flaw)
contracts.initial: two worlds stack (storm above, desert below)
contracts.trajectory: Björn draws Himinkljúfr and swings at the seam of light
contracts.contact: the blade passes through light/water — nothing to cut
contracts.consequence: the sword is useless here — the thesis of his arc is planted
contracts.final: the ship is driven onto the impossible shore
contracts.weaponCostume: Himinkljúfr DRAWN then sheathed; no damage dealt
contracts.camera: vertigo tilt between the stacked worlds

contracts.beat: first tide — muscle on her mind (Björn hauls IPU clear on Astrid's read)
contracts.initial: on the strand; a sudden WRONG tide gathers; ASTRID senses it
contracts.trajectory: ASTRID calls the line; BJÖRN sprints and bodily hauls IPU and a guard off the strand
contracts.contact: the water takes the strand a beat behind them
contracts.consequence: lives saved by HER read + HIS strength — first grudging trust
contracts.final: Björn sets IPU down, soaked, staring at Astrid (he acted without understanding)
contracts.raccord: cut to Meryt's reaction / Seth-Nakht's arrival (SC07)
contracts.weaponCostume: Himinkljúfr slung; no kill; no gore
contracts.camera: tracking sprint, then a tight two-shot Björn↔Astrid
